about: Programs whose `$` words the reference (test/reference.mjs) must read as the runtime does. runtime/tests/routed_repetition.rs checks each against the runtime: it expands to a text holding `expands_to` and loads, or it is refused with `refused`. test/reference.test.mjs checks the reference against `substitutions`: each `$` word in the program's for block bodies, in order, and how many characters of it, the `$` included, the runtime substitutes, 0 where it refuses the word. Each `source` is its lines.

cases.name: a $Q in a comment inside a rule whose code names a member by Q is substituted
source: place yard kind farm;
entity x_a kind exhibit at yard;
entity x_b kind exhibit at yard;
event confront about kind exhibit, shown kind exhibit;
for exhibit as $w routed by about {
state $w_n = 0;
on confront when $w_n >= $shown_n // compares $shown
set $w_n = 1;
cases.expands_to: on confront when about == 1 and shown == 2 and x_a_n >= x_b_n // compares x_b
